notes: Established 1879 and described as the first Protestant church in Tucson; near the UA main gate. ADDRESS RESOLVED 2026-09-10: the church's own contact page gives '915 E 4th Street, Tucson, Arizona 85719', so the E prefix is confirmed and the seed caveat can be dropped. Coordinates still missing - run tools/geocode.py. Staff page lists exactly two clergy: Rev. Dr. Eun Young Ko (Senior Pastor) and Rev. Raven Gaston (Pastor of Visitation) - the latter is the unnamed 'Pastor Raven' from the seed note. Gaston is listed as a pastor because she is clergy on staff and the home page shows her leading congregational activities, but the site nowhere states how often she preaches, so confirm the pulpit rotation before attributing any sermon to her. Two Sunday services: 10am English and 11:30am Korean, both streamed. Media: the YouTube channel @TucsonFirstUMC (UCJt_TWZCf0FY7kX222pQkQA) is active, but the regular Sunday services live in the channel's Streams tab, not Uploads - the Uploads tab is mostly music and 2020-21 material, so use https://www.youtube.com/@TucsonFirstUMC/streams as the sermon source (recorded there as a sermon_playlist_url even though it is a channel tab rather than a true playlist). Stream titles follow the pattern 'Sunday Morning Live! MM/DD/YYYY <Scripture reference>' and are duplicated in English and Korean, with no preacher named in the title, so preacher attribution will have to come from the video itself. Caption availability not yet checked.
